messages:
Mira: Quick sync 10m1 planning the "Spark Templates" micro-experiment. Goal: test whether bundling 5 curated prompt templates + $10 starter credits increases first-week API calls and prompt reuse compared to credits-only. Need routing, comms, landing variants, and post-claim nudges.
Kai: Nice. What are the variants?
Mira: Two arms: 
A) Templates + credits (bundle)
B) Credits-only (control).
Also we should test two landing headlines: technical vs outcome.
Anya: Routing: add a hidden field campaign="spark_templates_v1". If email domain matches a target account list, flag as high-priority and route to AE queue. Pseudo: 
```
if submission.campaign == "spark_templates_v1":
  if domain in target_accts:
    route = "ae"
  elif company_size > 50:
    route = "sdr"
  else:
    route = "growth_nurture"
```
Priya: On the credit assignment: require verification of template execution (simple server-side ping after user runs the provided example). Only award credits after that step to avoid abuse. We'll record template_id and partner_id if present.
Leo: From ops: expect small spike in activation metrics. Recommend configuring the outreach playbook: 24h follow-up email with tips + 72h prompt pack reminder. Also enable an experiment tag in Amplitude to split cohorts.
Mira: Benchmarks to track: 1) % of claimers who make >=1 API call in 24h, 2) median tokens per session first 7 days, 3) day-7 template reuse rate, 4) conversion to paid at 14 days.
Kai: Comms plan: LinkedIn carousel post + targeted email to developer list + partner co-mail. A/B test subject lines and landing copy. I'll draft copy variants.
Anya: For partner flows: generate partner link like https://redwood.ai/spark?pid=partnerX&utm=partner&utm_campaign=spark-23. Ensure partner_id flows through to SFDC and analytics.
Priya: I'll add partner_id param to form and include in lead payload. Backend will only mark credits granted if verification_event == true.
growth-bot: Experiment stub created: /playbooks/spark-templates (status: draft).
Mira: Task list: Kai -> copy + social assets by Mon. Priya -> form + verification logic + route PR by Wed. Anya -> routing config + AE mapping by Tue. Leo -> playbook messages and SDR coverage plan by Thu. I'll own launch calendar and dashboard.
Kai: Will include two headline variants: "Build usable LLM features in minutes" (outcome) and "5 production-ready prompt templates to ship faster" (technical).
Priya: PR target Wed AM, will include unit tests for verification job.
Mira: Quick poll for launch week 1 May 3 or May 10? React with :one: or :two:.
Kai: :two:
Leo: :two:
Anya: :one: (leaning)
Mira: Going with May 10 to give team buffer. Thanks all, will post calendar + playbook link.
